rules: The `SEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR controls access to the `seed` CSR from Supervisor (S) and Hypervisor (HS) modes.
The `USEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR controls access to the `seed` CSR from User (U) mode.
Writing a value of 1 to the `SEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR enables access to the `seed` CSR for Supervisor (S) and Hypervisor (HS) modes.
Writing a value of 1 to the `USEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR enables access to the `seed` CSR for User (U) mode.
Reading the `SEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR returns the value written to the field.
Reading the `USEED` field in the `mseccfg` CSR returns the value written to the field.
